description:
Power BI Desktop is open on the Windows desktop. A CSV file named 'employee_performance.csv' is available at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\PowerBITasks\employee_performance.csv. It contains 1000 rows of employee data with columns: ID, Name, Age, Gender, Department, Salary, Joining Date, Performance Score, Experience, Status, Location, Session.

Your task:
1. In Power BI Desktop, click 'Get Data' and import the file 'employee_performance.csv' from C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\PowerBITasks\.
2. After loading the data, go to the Data or Model view.
3. Create a new DAX measure called 'Average_Rating' with the formula: Average_Rating = AVERAGE(employee_performance[Performance Score])
4. Switch back to Report view and add a Card visual displaying the 'Average_Rating' measure.
5. Save the report as 'employee_report.pbix' on the Desktop (C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\).
